notes: Product title and ordering list 11 dB power budget; TECHNICAL DATA header states power budget 0–10.5 dB and dispersion penalty Max 1 dB without further numeric dispersion penalty detail. Bit rate support explicitly includes 100 Mbps to 1.25 Gbps (100 Mbps not entered in bit_rate_gbps to avoid unit conversion). Industrial variant SO-CSFP-1000Base-BX10D-43-O2-I: operating temperature -40°C to +85°C (-I). Transmitter output power, receiver minimum input power, and overload are average power (footnote 1). Receiver minimum input power and overload measured at 1.25 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back (footnote 2). Two LC connectors on SM single-fiber BiDi; each port Tx 1490 nm / Rx 1310 nm; far end requires BiDi SFP Tx 1310 nm / Rx 1490 nm. Power consumption < 1.0 W per BiDi function. DDM per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Consider separate temp_min_c/temp_max_c per ordering suffix (C-temp vs I-temp) or allow list of ranges. Add power_budget_db to schema for values like 0–10.5 dB and 11 dB in product naming. Allow bit_rate_mbps alongside bit_rate_gbps for multirate modules.
